candidate_grammar.boundary: Every supplied positive finite PROB-002 support, path, weight, record, decision rule and successor boundary.
candidate_grammar.generator: Generate the complete eight-axis PROB-002 product before observation access.
candidate_grammar.unique_survivor: PROB-002 uniquely retains conditional-support-composition, complete deterministic support custody, root forcing, post-registry observation and no extra rule.

excluded_inputs: no axiom, fitted parameter, imported stochastic law or target outcome selects the result
probability is exact generated-support correspondence and never an ontic randomness premise
host 0 denotes structural absence or counts artifacts only and is not an SFT number object
no negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof scalar
no asymptotic distribution or completed infinite trial sequence is admitted without a separate successor certificate
no failed route retires an obligation or changes protected authority
statement: Conditional support is the exact joint support relative to a declared nonempty support, and Bayes correspondence is the same joint custody read in the opposite order.
title: Conditional support and Bayes correspondence
